property_summary: After a Collect call, the contract's balance must not increase.
After Collect, the unlockTime of the caller must be at least the block timestamp.
After Collect, the caller's balance in Acc must be exactly its previous balance minus the collected amount.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's Acc.unlockTime must remain unchanged (≥ block.timestamp before the call).
After a Collect call, the caller's unlockTime must be greater than or equal to the block timestamp.

After a call to Collect(uint256) that does not revert, the balance of the sender in the contract must decrease by exactly the amount requested (if preconditions are met), regardless of the unlockTime.
After a call to Collect(uint256), the sender's unlockTime in storage remains unchanged from before the call.
After a Collect call that doesn't revert, the sender's balance before the call minus the amount requested is less than or equal to the sender's balance after the call.

After a call to Collect(uint256) that does not revert, the sender's balance before the call must be greater than or equal to the sender's balance after the call plus the amount withdrawn (if the unlock condition was met, otherwise unchanged).

After a call to Collect(uint _am) that does not revert, the sender's balance in storage decreases by exactly _am if and only if the sender's balance was at least MinSum and _am and the current timestamp exceeds the sender's unlockTime; otherwise the balance stays the same.
After a Collect call, the total balance of C (sum of all Holder balances) never exceeds the contract's ether balance minus msg.value just sent.
After Collect, the sum of all balances in the mapping never exceeds the contract's ether balance.
After any Collect call that does not revert, the balance of the caller remains greater than or equal to the minimum sum (1 ether) minus the amount collected.
After a Collect call that does not revert, the caller's balance in the Acc mapping is never negative.
After any Collect call, the caller's balance in the Acc mapping is never less than the amount collected.
The balance of an account can never decrease after a call to Collect.
After Collect, the sum of all balances in the mapping Acc plus the contract balance is invariant when caller sends 0 msg.value.
After a call to Collect, the sum of the sender's recorded balance and their remaining contract balance (msg.sender.balance + contract.balance) does not increase compared to before the call.
After calling Collect, msg.sender's balance in the mapping Acc (as returned by the Acc getter) does not increase.
After a call to Collect, the balance in the state variable MinSum is unchanged.
Collect only succeeds when block.timestamp is strictly greater than unlockTime, never when equal.
The sum of all balances in the Acc mapping never decreases after a Collect call that reverts.
Collect never succeeds when block.timestamp == acc.unlockTime.
Collect succeeds exactly when block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime, never when block.timestamp == acc.unlockTime.
Collect never decreases the caller's balance when block.timestamp equals unlockTime.
